title: Law to require ticket-selling businesses, not sellers, to get licensed
summary: This bill would remove the requirement that individual ticket sellers working in public spaces be personally licensed, and instead require the businesses that employ or engage them to hold a ticket-selling business license from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection. Violations by a ticket seller could affect the business's license, including denial or non-renewal in certain cases such as repeated unpaid fines or crimes connected to ticket sales. It would also raise the license fee from $45 annually to $90 for a two-year license and add related sight-seeing bus licensing provisions.
